description: AZURE DEVOPS ONLY -- Read the content of a wiki page (and its immediate sub-page paths). path uses wiki page-path syntax, e.g. '/Home' or '/Architecture/Deployment'. Requires DEVOPS_ORG_URL + DEVOPS_PAT env vars.

includeSubPages.description: Also list immediate sub-page paths under this page.

project.description: Optional: Azure DevOps project name. Falls back to DEVOPS_PROJECT env var.

wikiIdentifier.description: Wiki name or id. Omit to auto-resolve to the project's only/first wiki (call ado_wiki_list if there are several).

name: ado_wiki_get_page
